results.name: Criss Cross Leg Raises
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back with your legs extended straight out and your arms resting by your sides or under your lower back for support. Engage your core and lift both legs slightly off the floor.
Start crisscrossing your legs in a scissor motion, crossing your right leg over your left and then your left leg over your right.

Gradually move your legs upward while continuing to crisscross until they form a 45-degree angle with your torso. Then, lower them back down to just above the floor, maintaining the crisscross motion throughout.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and support your lower back.
Focus on using your leg muscles to control the movement, keeping your legs straight and performing the crisscross motion smoothly.
Ensure your lower back remains pressed into the floor to avoid unnecessary strain.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you move your legs upward and inhaling as you lower them.
results.description: Criss Cross Leg Raises is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps.

results.name: Crunch (Arms Straight)
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Extend your arms straight above your head, keeping them in line with your ears.
Engage your core and lift your shoulder blades off the floor, reaching your arms straight up towards the ceiling.
Lower your shoulder blades back to the floor with control, keeping your arms extended. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid using your neck or momentum to lift your shoulders; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Use a mat or soft surface to support your back and prevent discomfort during the exercise.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and inhaling as you lower them.
results.description: Crunch (Arms Straight) is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

results.name: Crunch (Legs on Stability Ball)
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back with your knees bent at a 90-degree angle and your lower legs resting on a stability ball.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
Lift your shoulder blades off the floor, curling your upper body towards your knees while keeping your legs stable on the ball.
Lower your shoulder blades back to the floor with control, maintaining your legs' position on the ball. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and support your lower back.
Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your shoulders.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and inhaling as you lower them.
results.description: Crunch (Legs on Stability Ball) is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a stability ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

results.name: Crunch (On BOSU Ball)
instructions: Begin by sitting on a BOSU ball with your feet flat on the floor and your knees bent.
Lean back to position your lower back against the BOSU ball, ensuring your upper body is supported. Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
Engage your core and lift your shoulder blades upwards, curling your upper body towards your knees.
Lower your shoulder blades back down with control, maintaining your core engagement. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your shoulders.
Use a mat or soft surface under the BOSU ball if needed for additional stability and comfort.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and inhaling as you lower them.
Ensure your lower back remains in contact with the BOSU ball to avoid unnecessary strain.
results.description: Crunch (On BOSU Ball) is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a bosu ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

results.name: Crunch (On Stability Ball)
instructions: Begin by sitting on a stability ball with your feet flat on the floor and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.

Walk your feet forward and lean back to position your lower and mid-back on the stability ball. Your upper body should be supported by the ball. Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
Engage your core and lift your shoulder blades upwards, curling your upper body towards your knees.
Lower your shoulder blades back down with control, maintaining your core engagement. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your shoulders.
Ensure your lower back remains in contact with the stability ball to avoid unnecessary strain.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and inhaling as you lower them.
results.description: Crunch (On Stability Ball) is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a stability ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

results.name: Crunch (Straight Leg Up)
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back with your legs extended straight up towards the ceiling. Keep your feet together, and your arms extended straight above your chest.
Engage your core and lift your shoulder blades off the floor, reaching your arms towards your toes.
Hold the crunch position briefly, squeezing your abdominal muscles at the top.
Lower your shoulder blades back to the floor with control, keeping your legs extended upward. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid using your neck or momentum to lift your shoulders; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Use a mat or soft surface to support your back and prevent discomfort during the exercise.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and inhaling as you lower them.
Ensure your lower back remains pressed into the floor to avoid unnecessary strain.

results.name: Crunch Frog on Floor
instructions: Begin seated on the floor, leaning back slightly. Your arms should be extended out to the sides at shoulder level, and your legs should be extended straight and parallel just above the floor.
Engage your core to simultaneously bring both knees towards your chest while lightly crunching your upper body towards your knees.
As you crunch, bring your arms together towards the sides of your knees.
Extend your legs back out and open your arms back to the starting position with control. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your legs and upper body, avoiding excessive use of momentum.
Ensure your lower back remains stable and avoid arching it during the movement.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you crunch and inhaling as you extend back out.
results.description: Crunch Frog on Floor is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

results.name: Crunch Leg Raise
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back with your knees bent and your feet just off the floor.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
Engage your core and lift your shoulder blades off the floor while simultaneously lifting your legs slightly to bring your knees towards your head.
Lower your back to the floor and your legs back to the starting position, keeping your feet just off the floor. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid using your neck or momentum to lift your shoulders; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Use a mat or soft surface to support your back and prevent discomfort during the exercise.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and knees, and inhaling as you lower them.
results.description: Crunch Leg Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.
